pageCache.pageTitle: St John's Wood Primary School - Promoting Fundamental British Values
pageCache.text:
Promoting Fundamental British Values
In accordance with The Department for Education we aim to actively promote British values in schools to ensure young people leave school prepared for life in modern Britain. Pupils are encouraged to regard people of all faiths, races and cultures with respect and tolerance and understand that while different people may hold different views about what is ‘right’ and ‘wrong’, all people living in England are subject to its law.

pageCache.pageTitle: St John's Wood Primary School - Our Vision
pageCache.text:
Our Vision
At St John’s Wood Primary School we aspire to create a welcoming and nurturing learning environment where every child thrives and discovers their unique potential. We deliver an exceptional primary education with a broad, balanced curriculum that ignites curiosity, fosters creativity, and equips each child to excel in the next stage of their education and beyond. High standards and inclusive values permeate every aspect of school life, where all children of all backgrounds and abilities feel inspired, supported, and celebrated.

pageCache.pageTitle: St John's Wood Primary School - New Parents
pageCache.text:
New Parents
Starting a new school can be an exciting time, but can cause some worries as well. At St. John’s Wood Primary we ensure that all children and their families are made to feel welcome from the start. An introductory meeting takes place with a member of the Senior Leadership Team.
At this meeting, we will find out about your child, their likes and dislikes and how we can best support them in school. Here you will receive an induction booklet which gives details about the school day. Once the meeting has taken place, we will then be able to share a start date.
Click on the links below to download the Upper School and Lower School Induction Handbooks:
